title: Clip 3:
length: about 2 min 30 s at full script (client label: 1:00)
headline: How do we protect the future? The answer has always been hope.
story: This is Clip 3 of the client’s final gala script, and the gala’s last word. It asks one question: how do we ensure a future of fairness and dignity? The answer: hope.

Cheryl is keeping hope alive. Sui says AIJ wants to be here “in perpetuity”, a shining star of hope for the next generation. Then “hope looks like…”, and the call to join. Highly hopeful and uplifting from start to end.

rows.visual: More family and community moments. B-roll TBD on scrub.

voice.quote: A future in which all people have a fair chance under the law … and are treated with dignity. A future in which families are not separated and children are protected.

voice.quote: The answer is – and has always been: HOPE.

voice.quote: I’m keeping hope alive, because I know how important the contribution of immigrants are, and not just to our economy, but especially to our economy … and especially at a time like this. So, I’m keeping hope alive. It’s never been easy. … the work of AI justice is more needed than ever.

rows.motion: Name plate on first sight: Sui Chung · Executive Director, Americans for Immigrant Justice.

voice.quote: Americans for Immigrant Justice, we’ve been here for 30 years. We want to be here in perpetuity. /// The next 30 years for Americans for Immigrant Justice, we want to be with the city of Miami, the state of Florida. We want to be with the United States and continuing to move forward with democratic principles, with the fight for human rights, for being that leader and that shining star of hope, of future, of being able to provide for the next generation.
voice.src: C9276 40:43.82–40:49.98 + 42:14.49–42:41.25 (A-cam FX3-3732 runs about 1.3 s later). The client wrote 42:14–42:43 for the second part only; the first line is at 40:44.

voice.quote: Every fact shared, every story told with care, joins the same effort: communicating the truth about who immigrants really are — contributing members of our community: business owners, medical professionals, families and communities building a better nation together.

rows.visual: Sui on camera (C9276 at 23:37). Frame not pulled.

voice.quote: We have to believe in the rule of law, due process, dignity, that we want to really stand by fellow humans, whether we’re here at Americans for Immigrant Justice, whether we’re community members that support the work of Americans for Immigrant Justice. I hope that many of us will join in this type of fight in terms of standing up for what’s right and standing up for our human neighbors.

voice.quote: Hope looks like a call from detention that gets answered.

voice.quote: Hope looks like a victim of domestic abuse or human trafficking, finding a path toward stability and growth. Hope looks like counting with people like you, who want to do something to protect our neighbors.
